subject: general
question: The value of the largest four-digit perfect square number divided by the smallest four- digit perfect square number will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Largest four-digit perfect square number = 9801

Smallest four-digit perfect square number = 1024

**Formula Used:**

Value = Largest four-digit perfect square number / Smallest four-digit perfect square number

**Calculation:**

Largest four-digit perfect square number = 99² = 9801

Smallest four-digit perfect square number = 32² = 1024

Value = 9801 / 1024

⇒ Value = 9.57

**The value of the largest four-digit perfect square number divided by the smallest four-digit perfect square number is less than 10.**
